name: exiftool
description: Comprehensive metadata reader/writer for images, videos, and documents

exiftool.description: Comprehensive metadata reader/writer for images, videos, and documents
exiftool.usage:
exiftool image.jpg # Read all metadata
exiftool -GPS* photo.jpg # Show GPS data
exiftool -overwrite_original -all= secure.jpg # Strip metadata
exiftool -r -ext jpg -GPSLatitude . # Find geotagged images

exiftool-k.description: ExifTool with -k option to keep console window open on Windows
exiftool-k.usage:
\"exiftool(-k).exe\" image.jpg # View metadata with persistent window
\"exiftool(-k).exe\" -all= clean_image.jpg # Remove all metadata
